title: Applied AI Engineering
description: Reconstructed 12-week Phase 11-first route for an FDE building applied AI skills. The earlier chat overlay was unavailable; this is a new implementation of the confirmed scope.

weeks.title: Prompting with a baseline
weeks.goal: Turn a real support workflow into a small, measurable product slice. Start directly in Phase 11; backfill prerequisites only when blocked.

tasks.label: Read prompt engineering, run its example, and attempt the quiz.
Read few shot cot, run its example, and attempt the quiz.
Read structured outputs, run its example, and attempt the quiz.
Create a 20-case input/output dataset, a prompt baseline, and a JSON output validator. Include ambiguous inputs and refusal cases.
Record baseline pass rate and five failures. Explain the user problem, acceptance criteria, and what you deliberately left out.
Write what failed, what changed, and what you can now explain. Add an artifact path or commit link below.

weeks.title: Context & evaluation
weeks.goal: Make quality measurable before adding retrieval or agents.

tasks.label: Read context engineering, run its example, and attempt the quiz.
Read evaluation, run its example, and attempt the quiz.
Build a repeatable eval runner with expected answers, a failure taxonomy, and a held-out split. Compare two prompt versions.
Save a versioned eval report. Define a minimum quality bar and explain why a small sample is not production proof.
Write what failed, what changed, and what you can now explain. Add an artifact path or commit link below.

weeks.title: Embeddings & retrieval

tasks.label: Read embeddings, run its example, and attempt the quiz.
Read rag, run its example, and attempt the quiz.
Index a small public document collection. Compare keyword and vector retrieval on 20 labeled questions; keep the source IDs.
Report retrieval recall and show a failure where the correct source is missing. Save the dataset and reproducible run command.
Write what failed, what changed, and what you can now explain. Add an artifact path or commit link below.

tasks.label: Read advanced rag, run its example, and attempt the quiz.
Add chunking, metadata filters, citations, and an insufficient-evidence response. Evaluate distractors, missing answers, and conflicting documents.
Deliver a runnable document Q&A prototype and a report separating retrieval failures from answer-generation failures.
Write what failed, what changed, and what you can now explain. Add an artifact path or commit link below.

tasks.label: Read function calling, run its example, and attempt the quiz.
Read guardrails, run its example, and attempt the quiz.
Add one tool with schema validation, an allowlist, a timeout, and a dry-run preview. Test prompt injection and invalid arguments.
Show a safe success and a blocked unsafe request. Require human confirmation before any external side effect.

weeks.goal: Understand the loop before choosing a framework.
